interval_basis: election-specific rule observation (Act 180/2014 Coll., version of 1 March 2023), not legal enactment dates
system_family: list proportional representation in one national district
allocation_method: national quota: votes of qualifying lists ÷ 151, then largest remainders (§ 68)

label.en: List votes (one list vote per voter)

national_rules.nationalAllocation: The votes of qualifying lists are divided by 151; each list receives the whole number of quotas in its votes, and remaining seats go to the largest remainders (§ 68).

description.en: Parties below 5% of valid votes take no part in the allocation (§ 66(2)(a)).
description.zh-CN: 低于有效票 5% 的政党不参与席位分配（第 66 条第 2 款 a 项）。

thresholds.appliesTo: coalition of two or three parties

description.en: Coalitions of two or three parties below 7% take no part (§ 66(2)(b)).
description.zh-CN: 两或三个政党组成的联盟低于 7% 时不参与（第 66 条第 2 款 b 项）。

thresholds.appliesTo: coalition of four or more parties

description.en: Coalitions of at least four parties below 10% take no part (§ 66(2)(c)).
description.zh-CN: 至少四个政党组成的联盟低于 10% 时不参与（第 66 条第 2 款 c 项）。

totalSeatsDefinition.en: 150 seats, as the sum of the elected counts printed in the minutes.
totalSeatsDefinition.zh-CN: 共 150 席，为会议记录所列当选人数之和。

notes.en: List proportional representation with one national district and 150 seats; thresholds 5%, 7% and 10% by list type. Published shares are truncated to two decimals. The minutes state a list kind only for lists that passed a threshold, so 18 lists have no established kind. Coalition votes and seats are not divided among members.
notes.zh-CN: 单一全国选区的名单比例代表制，共 150 席；门槛按名单类型分别为 5%、7%、10%。公布的得票率截断保留两位小数。会议记录仅载明通过门槛的名单类型，因此 18 个名单类型尚未确定。联盟的票数和席位不分配给各成员。
